meta.title: GreenPostel Global — Second-Generation Hybrid Post
meta.description: GreenPostel Global is a secure, economical and eco-friendly international hybrid postal solution that merges the traditional postal system with the digital world.
meta.keywords: hybrid post, digital mail, AES encryption, international delivery, eco-friendly post, GreenPostel

hero.subtitle: GreenPostel Global is an innovative hybrid postal solution that fixes the shortcomings of the traditional postal system and integrates it with the digital world. It separates single and bulk data, encrypts it end-to-end and delivers it securely to the nearest print center.

whatis.title: A secure, economical and ecological postal experience
whatis.p1: The project separates single and bulk data processing, encrypts it digitally, and ensures it is sent securely to the print centers of GreenPostel partners both domestically and internationally.
whatis.p2: This way, both customers and international postal organizations save time and cost; its eco-friendly approach shortens delivery time. The project was built to be secure, economical and ecological.
whatis.pill1Desc: End-to-end digital process with no format conversion needed.
whatis.pill2Desc: AES-encrypted data stays protected all the way to print.
whatis.pill3Desc: An ecological model that cuts carbon footprint and transit time.

mission.missionText: To integrate traditional postal processes with modern technologies, offering our users fast, secure, economical and eco-friendly solutions. We aim to lower organizations' communication costs while simplifying their business processes.
mission.visionText: To combine the power of the digital world with traditional postal services and build an innovative, sustainable and accessible communication platform for organizations.

architecture.title: From data to delivery, secure end to end
architecture.intro: Data sent from the user panel is encrypted with AES, routed by AI to the nearest print center, then printed, enveloped and delivered to the recipient with a QR tracking code.

steps.title: Data Submission
steps.desc: The user uploads letter data to the GreenPostel system from their own panel.

steps.title: AES Encryption
steps.desc: Data is encrypted end-to-end with AES 128 / 256 / 512 and securely separated.

steps.title: Smart Routing
steps.desc: AI routes the data to the print center nearest to the destination address.

steps.title: Print & Enveloping
steps.desc: AI-integrated machines read the data, print it and envelope it automatically.

steps.title: Handover to Post
steps.desc: Finished mail is handed over to national postal distribution organizations.

steps.title: QR Tracking & Delivery
steps.desc: The carrier delivers the mail to the recipient with a personal QR tracking code.

architecture.securityText: As soon as the user creates an account and signs in, the system encrypts the data with AES. This protection continues uninterrupted until the AI-integrated machines at the print center read and process the data.
architecture.option1Desc: Work directly from your web browser with no installation required.
architecture.option2Desc: Work in integration with the operating system you use.
architecture.formatNote: No format change required — GreenPostel adapts to every format.
